# Aziza Home

> Aziza Home (www.azizahomes.com) is a Dubai interior design company that sells turnkey apartment furnishing packages: one fixed-scope package designs, supplies, delivers, installs and styles a whole apartment so it is ready to live in, rent or list. Founded in 2022, based in Dubai, UAE. Aziza Home is an independent design company and is not affiliated with the property developer Azizi Developments. Clients are mainly property investors, landlords and holiday-home owners, including overseas owners who never visit the unit.

## Packages and prices

Every package is priced by layout (Studio, 1 Bedroom, 2 Bedroom, 3 Bedroom) and tier (Essential, Premium, Luxury). Prices are "from" prices in AED, excluding VAT and appliances (October 2026):

| Layout | Essential | Premium | Luxury |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio | AED 26,000 | AED 30,500 | AED 52,500 |
| 1 Bedroom | AED 34,500 | AED 42,000 | AED 76,000 |
| 2 Bedroom | AED 46,000 | AED 63,500 | AED 98,500 |
| 3 Bedroom | AED 60,500 | AED 84,000 | AED 115,000 |

- Essential: complete furniture, soft furnishings, lighting and styling; no feature wall.
- Premium: Essential plus a designed feature wall in the living area.
- Luxury: upgraded feature walls in the living room and bedroom, plus richer materials and styling.
- Seven style themes: Japandi (the house style), Aura, Terra, Modern Elite, Prestige, Regal and Minimalistic.
- Villas and townhouses are quoted per project.
- Typical timeline: 7–20 days from confirmation and building access, depending on package and layout.

## What is included

Interior design and a furniture plan, sourcing, delivery, building permits and service-elevator bookings, assembly and installation, wall treatments (Premium and Luxury), soft furnishings, styling, and a photo-ready handover.

## Who it is for

- Investors furnishing a new handover unit for long-term rent or holiday-home (Airbnb) use
- Landlords re-furnishing a vacant apartment
- Owners living abroad who need the whole job handled remotely
